name: Reboot My Heart
source:
Mathew’s love life is a disaster.

No matter how hard he tries, he just can’t win over a girl—not even his childhood friend, Masha. Frustrated, he takes matters into his own hands, building an advanced android designed to be his perfect match.

But when he runs the final script, something goes wrong… Instead of a dream girl, he gets a flawless male android—a mirror image of himself in both looks and personality. Now, Mathew must deal with the unexpected consequences of his own creation.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3530660/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
马修的爱情生活是一场灾难。

无论他如何努力，他都无法赢得女孩的青睐，甚至是他儿时的朋友玛莎。沮丧之余，他亲自动手，打造了一款先进的机器人，旨在与他完美匹配。

但当他运行最终的脚本时，出现了问题……他得到的不是一个梦想中的女孩，而是一个完美的男性机器人——无论是外表还是个性都是他自己的镜像。现在，马修必须应对他自己的创造带来的意想不到的后果。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3530660/]Steam[/url]]
